title: Portfolio
text: Used React.js, Bootstrap, and CSS for an interactive frontend. JavaScript functions were implemented to fetch images and create individual cards by pulling data from a JSON file.

title: CineMatch
text: CineMatch is a full-stack AI app that recommends movies and TV shows through chat or a quick-match form. A FastAPI backend and React frontend power the UI, while an OpenAI agent calls MCP tools to pull live TMDB data so every pick is grounded in real metadata, not model guesses.

title: Buzzr
text: This code creates a Discord bot using JavaScript, Node.js, and Discord.js to manage SMS notifications via the Twilio API. It uses SQLite for data storage and is currently handling a sports betting server with over 100 members, ensuring efficient and scalable communication.
